labs.pi_title: Center Director; Professor of Global Development Policy, Pardee School of Global Studies
labs.research_summary: A university-wide policy research center at Boston University, founded in 2017, working on financial stability, human well-being and environmental sustainability through research, policy dialogue and student training.
labs.join_notes: The careers page lists a call for the 2027-2028 GDP Center Fellowship Program (pre- and post-doctoral applicants, with a link to the call) and a Program Assistant and Communications Fellow post for the Human Capital Initiative, open to current BU students only and applied for through JobX (job id 12165).
